meta.title: Hush Studio Build Plan
meta.subtitle: Hush Studio: the recording and render app for the Sam Katz Hypnosis channel. Migrated 2026-11-10 from ops/state.json.

guide.heading: What this is
rows: Task plan for Hush Studio (sound recording app, repo folder pika_meditate). Narthen Control reads and edits this file.
CLAUDE.md is the architectural source of truth. Render speed is the #1 requirement: encode each unique piece once, build the long video by stream-copy.
Docs/Engine Build Plan/engine_plan.json (path kept from Narthen Control's defaults). The workbook is generated from it; never edit the .xlsx directly.

milestones.name: Fix recording quality
milestones.goal: Found in testing 2026-11-10: the audio sounds distorted and has cuts. Nothing else ships until a take records, masters and renders clean.
milestones.exit: Root causes found and fixed; an automated check catches clipping, distortion and dropouts; a real take is verified clean by ear and by test.

milestones.name: Verify and publish
milestones.goal: Prove the shipped pipeline on real material and publish to the real channel account.
milestones.exit: Full pytest green, FINISH timing on Sam's real take recorded, a real YouTube upload tested.

milestones.name: Editing workflow
milestones.goal: Sam can review and adjust everything the auto-editor proposes before render.
milestones.exit: Flub-cut proposals reviewable (accept/undo); induction-phase marker pauses handled.

milestones.name: Takes and editor
milestones.goal: After recording, an Edit button opens an Audacity-style editor so Sam can edit by hand or still use the automated features. Takes are saved, browsable, importable and exportable.
milestones.exit: Takes library with file-explorer view; import/export; in-app waveform editor; open in Audacity at any point.

milestones.name: Publishing and integrations
milestones.goal: Manage intros, set YouTube thumbnails, and connect Riverside and Canva.
milestones.exit: Intros can be uploaded and swapped; thumbnails upload with the video; Riverside and Canva workflows decided and built.

milestones.name: Later scope
milestones.goal: Features deferred until the recording workflow is solid.

zones.name: Core pipeline
zones.rules: Any change that re-encodes the full-length output needs explicit sign-off (see CLAUDE.md).

zones.name: UI and companion
zones.rules: PyQt6; never touch widgets off the GUI thread. Brand: samkatz.store white and purple.

zones.name: Docs and plan
zones.rules: Small edits; append to the log.

decisions.question: How should the hand-editor work?
decisions.options: Build our own waveform editor in the PyQt app; only hand off to Audacity; both.
decisions.recommendation: Both. A simple in-app editor (select, cut, delete, silence, undo, zoom, play, plus buttons for the automated features) so Sam never leaves the app, and an Open in Audacity round-trip for anything heavier.

decisions.question: How deep should the Riverside integration go?
decisions.options: Drag/watch-folder import of Riverside exports; Riverside API (if her plan includes it); both.
decisions.recommendation: Start with a smooth import of Riverside exports (watch folder + drag-in, auto-detect 44.1 kHz mono). Add the API only if her plan exposes recording downloads.
decisions.outcome: Needs: which Riverside plan does Sam have, and does she want pull-from-Riverside inside the app?

decisions.question: How should Canva fit in?
decisions.options: Open Canva with a thumbnail template and import the exported PNG; Canva Connect API (OAuth, export design); both.
decisions.recommendation: Start with open-in-Canva plus importing the exported PNG from a watched folder. Connect API later if Sam wants one-click export from inside the app.
decisions.outcome: Needs: does Sam already have a Canva thumbnail template to reuse?

decisions.question: Where do saved takes live, and what is a take?
decisions.options: Folder per take under a user-chosen Takes folder; single-file bundle; database index.
decisions.recommendation: Folder per take (raw audio, edit list, notes, metadata), in a Takes folder Sam can see in Explorer, with an exported .hushtake zip as the shareable form.

baseline: As recorded in CLAUDE.md section 0.6 (2026-11-09). Re-run under T6.

budget.plans: Claude and Codex subscription plans. Caps come from ops/state.json: 90% weekly, 95% five-hour.
tiers: Decisions and real-account tests that are yours
rules: Start each task fresh and paste `build_engine_plan.py --show <ID>`.
Name the Key files from the task instead of asking an agent to explore.
Near a usage limit, stop at a clean point and leave notes.

log.text: Migrated the six tasks from ops/state.json into Narthen Control's plan format. Task IDs unchanged.

Re-planned after Sam's first test: audio distortion and cuts become P0 (M0). Added takes library, import/export, Audacity-style editor with an Edit button, open in Audacity, intro manager, thumbnails, Riverside and Canva. Decisions D01-D04 opened.

tasks.title: Test YouTube upload with Sam's real Google account (private-lock limitation shown)
tasks.why: The uploader is only tested against a fake server. Unverified API projects are locked to private; the app must show that plainly.
tasks.scope: Sam signs in with the channel's Google account and uploads a short test video. Confirm resumable upload, metadata from youtube_template.toml, and the private-lock notice.
tasks.acceptance: A test video appears in YouTube Studio with the expected title, tags and description, and the app shows the private-lock message.
tasks.verify: Manual: upload in the app, check YouTube Studio.

tasks.title: Update CLAUDE.md Module C to match shipped mastering (-21 LUFS, light chain)
tasks.why: Module C still describes -14 LUFS and an HPF/compressor chain; the shipped chain targets -21 LUFS with gain plus limiter.
tasks.scope: Rewrite Module C to match core/master.py.
tasks.acceptance: Module C describes the shipped chain and -21 LUFS; no contradiction with section 0.5.

tasks.title: Auto-edit: handle shorter induction-phase marker pauses
tasks.why: Sam's occasional shorter marker pauses in the induction phase are not automated yet.
tasks.scope: Detect and shape the shorter induction-phase marker pauses in core/auto_edit.py, keeping the existing behaviour for normal markers.
tasks.acceptance: On Sam's real raw take, induction-phase markers are replaced with the shorter pause lengths; existing auto-edit tests still pass.

tasks.title: Review UI: flub-cut proposals Sam can accept/undo before render
tasks.why: Sam does flub cuts herself in review; the app should propose them and let her accept or undo each.
tasks.scope: Show proposed cuts in the review screen with preview, accept and undo, feeding the edit list before render.
tasks.acceptance: Each proposed cut can be previewed, accepted or undone, and the render honours the result.
tasks.verify: pytest tests/test_ui.py; manual review pass on a real take.

tasks.title: Repurpose feature: rearrange old audio into a new session (deferred scope)
tasks.why: Sam sometimes reuses or rearranges old audio into a new session. Deferred until new-recording workflow is solid.
tasks.scope: To be scoped with Sam before any work starts.

tasks.title: Run full pytest + end-to-end FINISH timing on Sam's real take; record in CLAUDE.md 0.6
tasks.why: Section 0.6 records numbers from 2026-11-09; they should be re-measured after recent changes.
tasks.scope: Run the full test suite and a real-take FINISH to exactly 8 h; record timings in CLAUDE.md section 0.6.
tasks.acceptance: pytest green; FINISH timing and exact 8h 00m 00s result recorded in CLAUDE.md 0.6.
tasks.verify: pytest; python main.py FINISH on the real take.

tasks.title: Find and fix the distorted audio in recorded takes
tasks.why: Reported from testing 2026-11-10: the output sounds distorted. Cause not yet known.
tasks.scope: Reproduce with a real mic take. Bisect the chain stage by stage (raw capture, denoise, auto-edit/splice, master gain and limiter, AAC encode) by listening to and measuring each stage's output (clipping, peak, THD, spectrum). Candidates to check, unconfirmed: input gain or clipping at capture, denoise artefacts, limiter or gain stage, crossfades at cuts, sample-rate mismatch. Fix the cause; do not mask it.
tasks.acceptance: A real take is clean at every stage and in the final MP4, confirmed by ear. The stage that introduced the distortion is named in the notes with before/after measurements.
tasks.verify: Per-stage measurements on a real take plus a listening check; tests added by T9.
tasks.notes: Hypotheses only. Start from the raw FLAC: if raw is clean, move downstream one stage at a time.

tasks.title: Find and fix the audio cuts (dropouts) in takes
tasks.why: Reported from testing 2026-11-10: there are cuts in the audio. Could be capture drops, plane-guard cuts, auto-edit, or the stitcher.
tasks.scope: Work out where the cuts come from: capture queue drops (the capture counter), plane-guard cut regions, auto-edit pause shaping, or seams in the stitched output. Compare the raw FLAC to the final output on the same take and locate each gap. Fix the cause. Surface any dropped-frame count in the UI so a bad take is obvious before FINISH.
tasks.acceptance: No unintended gaps in a real take's output. Dropped capture frames are counted and shown. Intentional cuts (plane cuts, pause shaping) are reviewable.
tasks.verify: Gap detection script over raw vs final on a real take; tests added by T9.
tasks.notes: Check whether the cuts are plane-guard false alarms first; the guard cuts audio on its own judgement.

tasks.title: Automated audio quality checks (clipping, distortion, dropouts)
tasks.why: The suite passed (171 tests) while real takes sounded distorted and had cuts. The tests did not cover real-signal quality.
tasks.scope: Add checks that run on a recorded or fixture speech take through the whole chain: clipped-sample count, peak and true-peak headroom, a distortion measure, and gap/dropout detection against the source. Fail the test and show a warning in the app on a bad take.
tasks.acceptance: Tests fail on a deliberately clipped or gapped input and pass on a clean one. A bad take shows a visible warning before FINISH.
tasks.notes: Do not use synthetic voices with the neural denoiser (it removes them); use a real speech clip.

tasks.title: Takes library: save takes and manage them in a file-explorer view
tasks.why: Takes are only a folder under sessions/ today. Sam needs to save takes, find them, rename, delete and reopen them without hunting through folders.
tasks.scope: Every recording is saved as a take (raw audio, edit list, notes, metadata). A Takes screen lists them with name, date, length, status (raw, edited, rendered, uploaded); rename, delete, duplicate, search, Show in Explorer, and reopen into the editor or render. Layout per decision D04.
tasks.acceptance: Record, close the app, reopen it: the take is listed and can be opened, renamed, duplicated and deleted. Show in Explorer opens the right folder.
tasks.verify: pytest tests for the takes module; manual run through the Takes screen.

tasks.title: Import and export takes
tasks.why: Sam needs to bring in recordings from elsewhere and move takes between machines or back them up.
tasks.scope: Import audio files (wav, mp3, m4a, flac) and Hush Studio take bundles. Export a take as a bundle (raw + edit list + metadata), as edited audio (wav/flac/mp3) and as the finished MP4. Drag and drop onto the Takes screen.
tasks.acceptance: A take exported as a bundle and imported on another install restores identically, including its edit list. Importing a plain audio file creates a take.

tasks.title: In-app waveform editor (Audacity-style) with the automated features as buttons
tasks.why: Sam wants to edit her take by hand, like Audacity, and still use the automated features when she wants.
tasks.scope: Waveform view with zoom and scroll, playback from any point, selection, cut, delete, insert or set silence, copy and paste, fade, undo and redo, and markers. Buttons: Auto-edit pauses, Remove plane noise, Normalise. Every change is stored in the take's edit list (non-destructive, raw is never touched). Must stay fast on a 30-40 min take.
tasks.acceptance: Sam can open a take, make manual cuts and silences, undo them, run the automated features on all or part of the take, and render the result. Raw audio is unchanged.
tasks.verify: pytest for the edit-list operations; manual editing session on a real take.
tasks.notes: Subsumes the cut review in T4: flub-cut proposals appear as editable regions here.

tasks.title: Edit button after recording opens the editor
tasks.why: After recording stops, Sam should be able to press Edit rather than going straight to Finish and render.
tasks.scope: When a take is finished, show Edit next to Finish and render; Edit opens the take in the editor, and Finish from there renders it.
tasks.acceptance: Stop recording, press Edit, make a change, press Finish and render: the output includes the change.

tasks.title: Open the audio in Audacity at any point, and bring the edits back
tasks.why: Sam wants to jump into Audacity at any stage for anything the app's editor does not do.
tasks.scope: Open in Audacity from the Takes screen, the editor and the review screen: export the current audio to a wav, launch Audacity on it (detect the install path), and include a label track for the cut and pause markers and the playhead position so the cursor opens where she was. After Audacity, offer Import changes to bring the exported file back as a new version of the take.
tasks.acceptance: From a take, Open in Audacity launches Audacity with the audio and markers. Importing the result back creates an updated take without losing the original.
tasks.verify: Manual with Audacity installed; pytest for the label export and import.
tasks.notes: Audacity has no command-line seek, so position is carried by a label track and the exported file, not a launch flag. Confirm at implementation time.

tasks.title: Intro manager: upload, replace and version intros
tasks.why: The intro card changes or gets updated. Sam must be able to upload a new one herself without touching files.
tasks.scope: An Intros screen: upload a video or image intro, preview it, name it, choose the active one, and keep older ones. Changing the active intro rebuilds the cached intro and black loop automatically (hash-keyed cache already exists). Validate resolution, frame rate and length, and show a clear message if the file is unsuitable.
tasks.acceptance: Upload a new intro, set it active, finish a take: the render uses it and the old one is still available. A bad file is rejected with an understandable message.
tasks.verify: pytest for cache rebuild on intro change; manual upload.
tasks.notes: Intro is a silent video card at the start of the video track; audio starts at t = 0 (see CLAUDE.md 0.5).

tasks.title: YouTube thumbnail: choose or upload one per video
tasks.why: Each upload needs a custom thumbnail; today the app has none.
tasks.scope: Pick or drop an image on the upload screen, validate it (16:9, 1280x720 recommended, under 2 MB, jpg or png), preview it, and send it with thumbnails.set after the video uploads. Remember a default thumbnail folder.
tasks.acceptance: An uploaded video shows the chosen thumbnail in YouTube Studio. A wrong-size or oversized image is flagged before upload.
tasks.verify: Tested against the fake server in tests; real account via T1.
tasks.notes: YouTube only allows custom thumbnails on verified channels; show that plainly if the call is refused.

tasks.title: Better Riverside integration
tasks.why: Sam records in Riverside and edits it, so getting Riverside takes into the app should be one step.
tasks.scope: At minimum: a watched Riverside download folder and drag-in that creates a take from a Riverside export (44.1 kHz mono, gated pauses, resample to 48 kHz on import). Extend to the Riverside API only if decision D02 says her plan supports it.
tasks.acceptance: A new Riverside export appears as a take with one click or automatically, ready to edit.
tasks.verify: Import a real Riverside export; pytest for the import conversion.
tasks.notes: Blocked on D02 for anything beyond folder import.

tasks.title: Canva integration for thumbnails
tasks.why: Sam makes thumbnails in Canva. The app should shorten the trip from take to finished thumbnail.
tasks.scope: Per decision D03: Open in Canva (with her template link) from the upload screen, a watched export folder that offers the newest PNG as the thumbnail, and later the Canva Connect API if wanted.
tasks.acceptance: From the upload screen Sam opens Canva, exports, and the exported image is picked up as the thumbnail without manual file hunting.
tasks.verify: Manual run with a real Canva export.
tasks.notes: Canva Connect API needs OAuth and app approval; do not start it until D03 is decided.
